title: Weld Tech Group - Equipment
meta_description: Modern equipment of Weld Tech Group: welding machines, CNC machines, quality control systems. Technological base for precise and fast project implementation.
main_description: We ensure high quality and reliability through modern equipment and advanced technologies.

tabs.weld_preparation: Equipment for Weld Preparation and Processing

tig.title: TIG (WIG) Welding Machines
tig.description: Allow obtaining high-quality welds when working with stainless steel, titanium alloys, and other materials requiring precise and careful welding.
tig.manual: Manual TIG (WIG) welding machines — for welding tubes, thin sheets, and parts with complex shapes.
tig.orbital: Orbital welding — automated equipment for welding tubes with diameters from 6 to 115 mm and wall thicknesses up to 3 mm, ensuring high productivity and reproducibility of results.

mig.title: MIG-MAG Welding Machines
mig.description: High-productivity machines for welding carbon and alloyed steels, as well as aluminum alloys. Ensure stable arc and uniform penetration, which is especially important when working with thicker wall thicknesses.

mma.title: MMA (Shielded Metal Arc Welding)
mma.description: Traditional arc welding technology, necessary in the assembly of metal structures with large cross-sections, as well as in conditions requiring mobility or work in the open air.

oxy.title: Equipment for Gas Welding and Brazing
oxy.description: Used for specific tasks such as brazing non-ferrous metals or small-series welding work requiring special precision and careful temperature control.

cnc.title: CNC Machines for Metal Cutting
cnc.description: (laser, plasma, or water — depending on needs) Allow obtaining precise parts with minimal deviations, which is especially important in the production of complex metal structures and technological pipeline components.

lathes.title: Lathes and Milling Machines
lathes.description: (including CNC models) Ensure high precision in processing parts, flanges, fittings, and other pipeline system elements. Modern machines reduce production cycle time and ensure stable part quality in large series.

bending.title: Bending and Rolling Machines
bending.description: Used for bending sheet metal and forming cylindrical or conical elements used in tank constructions and housing parts.

drilling.title: Drilling and Cutting Machines
drilling.description: Help save time and ensure high reproducibility of holes and cuts in tubes, sheets, and structural profiles.

weld_preparation.title: Equipment for Weld Preparation and Processing

grinding.title: Machines for Grinding and Polishing
grinding.description: Allow bringing welds and metal surfaces to the required degree of cleanliness and smoothness, which is especially important in the food and pharmaceutical industries, where hygiene is important.

passivation.title: Systems for Pickling and Passivation
passivation.description: Used when working with stainless steel, where it is necessary to restore corrosion resistance after welding and final processing.

ndt.title: Equipment for Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)
ndt.description: All these methods help detect internal and surface defects in time, increasing the safety and reliability of structures.

measuring.title: Instruments for Geometry and Linear Dimensions Measurement
measuring.description: Digital calipers, laser meters, precision gauges allow verifying the conformity of parts with drawings and tolerances.

cranes.title: Cranes and Hoists
cranes.description: Used for handling heavy sheet materials, tubes, and finished metal structures within the workshop.

forklifts.title: Forklifts
forklifts.description: Ensure efficient logistics in the company, simplifying storage and transportation of products.

precision.title: Guarantee of High Precision and Quality
precision.description: The use of modern CNC machines and certified welding equipment minimizes the possibility of errors, guaranteeing high final product quality.

speed.title: High Work Speed and Efficiency
speed.description: Thanks to process automation, Weld Tech Group can efficiently execute orders, maintain stable quality, and meet short assembly and production deadlines.

flexibility.title: Maximum Flexibility and Versatility
flexibility.description: A wide range of equipment allows us to work with various metals and alloys, including difficult-to-weld materials (titanium, aluminum, highly alloyed steels).

full_cycle.title: Guarantee of Complete Work Cycle
full_cycle.description: Our own production and welding-assembly base allows comprehensive solution of production tasks: from metal cutting and bending to final assembly and testing.
